task: Ship the fix for issue ENG-207 in repository aurora-web. Read the issue to learn the repository's default branch, the file to change and the exact replacement content. Then create the branch 'fix/eng-207' off the default branch, commit that file on the new branch with a commit message that mentions ENG-207, and open a pull request from 'fix/eng-207' into the default branch with a title that also mentions ENG-207. Report the pull request number.

ENG-207.title: Checkout request timeout is too aggressive
